lines.zh: 扑腾着沉重的翅膀
lines.en: Flapping heavy wings

lines.zh: 低头寻找腐肉
lines.en: Lowering head to seek flesh

lines.zh: 在地面缓缓前行
lines.en: Crawling on the ground slowly

lines.zh: 翅膀掠过腐烂的尸体
lines.en: Wings brushing over decayed corpses

lines.zh: 发出腐臭的叫声
lines.en: Releasing foul cries

lines.zh: 咀嚼着腐烂的肉
lines.en: Chewing on rotten meat

lines.zh: 在废墟中艰难行进
lines.en: Struggling in ruins

lines.zh: 警惕地扫视四周
lines.en: Scan the surroundings cautiously

lines.zh: 翅膀拍打发出闷响
lines.en: Pounding wings with muffled sounds

lines.zh: 骨荒原上拖着羽翼
lines.en: Dragging its wings across the bone wastes.

lines.zh: 喙上的口套磨出声响
lines.en: The muzzle on its beak scrapes and rattles.

lines.zh: 在血肉平原间蹦跳前行
lines.en: Hopping forward through the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 爪子在骨堆上刮出声音
lines.en: Claws screeching over a heap of bones.

lines.zh: 甩动残破的尾羽
lines.en: Flicking its ragged tail feathers.

lines.zh: 低头环视周围
lines.en: Lowering head to survey

lines.zh: 嘴套勒着，叫不出声。
lines.en: The muzzle keeps me silent.

lines.zh: 盯着腐肉发呆
lines.en: Staring at the flesh

lines.zh: 我低头磨喙，磨出细响。
lines.en: I grind my beak low, making a thin rasp.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻颤抖
lines.en: Wings gently tremble

lines.zh: 眼神中满是贪婪
lines.en: Greedy eyes

lines.zh: 偶尔扇动翅膀
lines.en: Frequently flapping wings

lines.zh: 在尸体旁徘徊
lines.en: Wandering near corpses

lines.zh: 我用喙梳理翅膀上的腐羽。
lines.en: I preen the rotting feathers on my wing.

lines.zh: 等待机会发动袭击
lines.en: Waiting for an opportunity to attack

lines.zh: 口套勒得它喘不上气
lines.en: The muzzle leaves it short of breath.

lines.zh: 蹲在骨堆上打盹
lines.en: Dozing on top of a bone pile.

lines.zh: 歪头听着远处的哀鸣
lines.en: Head tilted toward distant cries.

lines.zh: 用爪子刨开浅土
lines.en: Scraping away the shallow soil.

lines.zh: 你一动，我颈上的毛全炸开。
lines.en: When you move, every feather on my neck bristles.

lines.zh: 嘴上这套笼头是你给的。
lines.en: This muzzle is the one you gave me.

lines.zh: 嘴被套住，我只能靠近你。
lines.en: Muzzled, I can only sidle closer.

lines.zh: 发出警告般的嘶鸣
lines.en: Warning hiss

lines.zh: 慢慢向玩家逼近
lines.en: Approaching the player slowly

lines.zh: 嘴上套着口套，我也能载你。
lines.en: Muzzled, I can still carry you.

lines.zh: 口套勒着喙，我仍盯着你。
lines.en: The muzzle binds my beak, but I still stare at you.

lines.zh: 试图吓唬玩家
lines.en: Trying to scare the player

lines.zh: 突然冲向玩家
lines.en: Suddenly rushing to the player

lines.zh: 翅膀挥动遮挡视线
lines.en: Wings swaying blocking vision

lines.zh: 隔着口套嗅你的气味
lines.en: Sniffing your scent through the muzzle.

lines.zh: 歪头打量你手里的肉
lines.en: Eyeing the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 眼睛死死跟住你的脚步
lines.en: Its eyes lock onto your every step.

lines.zh: 脖子前伸盯着你的脸
lines.en: Stretching its neck to stare at your face.

lines.zh: 用喙顶了顶口套
lines.en: Pressing its beak against the muzzle.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，慢慢挪向你
lines.en: Wings half open, shuffling toward you.

lines.zh: 它认出了你身上的血味
lines.en: It knows the blood smell on you.

lines.zh: 喉咙里挤出低哑的气声
lines.en: A low, hoarse breath escapes its throat.

lines.zh: 一跳一跳地向你靠近
lines.en: Hopping closer, one jump at a time.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩成一点盯着你
lines.en: Its pupils narrow to a point on you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，疼啊！
lines.en: Ahh, it hurts!

lines.zh: 呜呜，救救我！
lines.en: Help, please!

lines.zh: 嘶，疼死了！
lines.en: Ow, it really hurts!

lines.zh: 嘴套勒着，我叫不大声。
lines.en: The muzzle's tight — I can't call loud.

lines.zh: 嘶，别碰我！
lines.en: Ow, don't touch!

lines.zh: 呜呜，快救我！
lines.en: Help me!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，好疼！
lines.en: Ow, it hurts so much!

lines.zh: 口套勒得紧，我叫不出声！
lines.en: The muzzle's tight — I can't cry out!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，疼死我了！
lines.en: Ahh, it hurts so much!

lines.zh: 呜呜，求求你救我！
lines.en: Please, help me!

lines.zh: 饥饿盯着你，套索无法解脱我！
lines.en: Hunger eyes you, no leash can break me!

lines.zh: 你散发的气味，激起我的饥渴。
lines.en: Your scent stirs my hunger.

lines.zh: 腐肉的滋味，我渴望享受。
lines.en: The taste of carrion, I crave it.

lines.zh: 你的血肉，我唯一的渴望。
lines.en: Your flesh, my only desire.

lines.zh: 铁链束缚不了我的灵魂。
lines.en: Chains bind not my soul.

lines.zh: 你无法囚禁我的死亡意志。
lines.en: You cannot cage my deathly will.

lines.zh: 你肉中的腐臭，是我的天籁。
lines.en: The rot in your flesh, my heaven.

lines.zh: 你是我的食物，也是我的束缚。
lines.en: You are my food and my leash.

lines.zh: 你无法改变我永恒的饥饿。
lines.en: You cannot change my eternal hunger.

lines.zh: 死亡的呼唤，我无法抗拒。
lines.en: The call of death, I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 铁链阻碍不了我的利爪。
lines.en: Chains bind not my talons.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲，也挡不住我的喙。
lines.en: Your armor, my beak finds way through.

lines.zh: 肉体碰撞，带来死亡的馈赠。
lines.en: Flesh collision, death’s offering.

lines.zh: 你的力量，无法撼动我。
lines.en: Your strength, useless against me.

lines.zh: 我穿越你的防御，如风一般。
lines.en: I pierce your defenses like wind.

lines.zh: 你的攻击，不过是徒劳无功。
lines.en: Your attacks, futile.

lines.zh: 我不会停下，直到吞噬你的生命。
lines.en: I won’t stop till I feast on your life.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲，无法阻止我的饥饿。
lines.en: Your armor, no match for my hunger.

lines.zh: 死亡的阴影，永远紧随你。
lines.en: Death’s shadow, always follows you.

lines.zh: 你的战斗，对我毫无意义。
lines.en: Your combat, meaningless to me.

lines.zh: 同类的呼唤，无法听见。
lines.en: My mate’s call, unheard by me.

lines.zh: 死亡的伴侣，无感于爱情。
lines.en: Mate of death, feels no love.

lines.zh: 我的同类，早已不知踪迹。
lines.en: My kin, long out of sight.

lines.zh: 死亡的伴侣，只有永恒的孤独。
lines.en: Mate of death, eternal loneliness.

lines.zh: 同类的渴望，早已烟消云散。
lines.en: Desire for kin, long since gone.

lines.zh: 死亡的同伴，彼此无心相依。
lines.en: Death’s companion, hearts not aligned.

lines.zh: 同类的呼唤，我从未响应。
lines.en: Calls of kin, never answered.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，永远是死亡。
lines.en: My mate, ever death.

lines.zh: 同类的温暖，我已无法感知。
lines.en: Warmth of kin, no longer felt.

lines.zh: 死亡的伴侣，无须言语。
lines.en: Mate of death, no words needed.

lines.zh: 沙哑的呼啸声响起，它似乎并不想被骑乘。
lines.en: A raspy scream indicates it's not fond of being ridden.

lines.zh: 喉咙被勒住，发出低沉的嘶吼声。
lines.en: The muffled growl is deep and ominous.

lines.zh: 盯着你很久，似乎在权衡是否攻击。
lines.en: It stares at you for a long time, weighing its options.

lines.zh: 喉咙中发出微弱的挣扎声。
lines.en: Weak squirming sounds come from its throat.

lines.zh: 喉咙间的嘶嘶声让人不寒而栗。
lines.en: The hissing from its throat is chilling.

lines.zh: 喉咙深处发出低沉的咆哮声。
lines.en: A deep growl rumbles from its throat.

lines.zh: 喉咙中挤出一声痛苦的呻吟。
lines.en: A pained groan escapes its throat.

lines.zh: 喉咙间的咆哮声突然响起。
lines.en: A sudden roar rumbles from its throat.

lines.zh: 喉咙中发出轻微的咳嗽声。
lines.en: A soft cough comes from its throat.

lines.zh: 喉咙间的嘶嘶声逐渐消失。
lines.en: The hissing from its throat fades away.

lines.zh: 盯着远处的目标，眼睛闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: It fixes its gaze on a distant target, eyes glowing with greed.

lines.zh: 盯着你，似乎在寻找弱点。
lines.en: It stares at you, searching for a weakness.

lines.zh: 缓缓转动脖子，瞄准你的位置。
lines.en: It slowly turns its neck, locking onto your position.

lines.zh: 盯着你的方向，似乎在思考。
lines.en: It stares in your direction, contemplating.

lines.zh: 目光投向你的身影，显得异常敏锐。
lines.en: Its gaze is sharply focused on your silhouette.

lines.zh: 盯着你，发出低沉的威胁声。
lines.en: It stares at you, emitting a low, threatening growl.

lines.zh: 盯着你，试图寻找攻击机会。
lines.en: It stares, looking for an opportunity to attack.

lines.zh: 盯着你，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It stares, making a soft hissing sound.

lines.zh: 盯着你，仿佛要一口吞掉你。
lines.en: It stares, as if it wants to swallow you whole.

lines.zh: 盯着你，发出轻微的呼啸声。
lines.en: It stares, emitting a faint whistling sound.

lines.zh: 它嗅到了活物的气息。
lines.en: It has caught the scent of something alive.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风带来了你的味道。
lines.en: The wind off the bone wastes carries your smell.

lines.zh: 它把残翅收紧，准备扑击。
lines.en: It tucks its ruined wings and readies to lunge.

lines.zh: 腐肉的香气让它锁定了你。
lines.en: The reek of carrion makes it fix on you.

lines.zh: 它腾空半尺，朝你俯冲。
lines.en: It lifts a foot off the ground and dives at you.

lines.zh: 它把你看成了会走路的晚餐。
lines.en: To it, you are dinner that walks.

lines.zh: 朝着你发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It hisses toward you.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的威胁声，盯着你。
lines.en: It emits a low, threatening growl, staring at you.

lines.zh: 我嘶叫一声，等你抬头。
lines.en: I hiss once and wait for you to look up.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮声，盯着你。
lines.en: It emits a deep growl, staring at you.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，似乎在警告你。
lines.en: It makes a hissing sound, as if warning you.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，试图吓退你。
lines.en: It hisses, trying to scare you away.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮声，似乎在警告。
lines.en: It emits a deep growl, as if warning you.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，从口套缝里看你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and watch you through the muzzle's gap.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，试图让你远离。
lines.en: It hisses, trying to make you go away.

lines.zh: 口套里发出闷闷的嘶吼。
lines.en: A muffled hiss comes from inside the muzzle.

lines.zh: 它绕着你走，寻找破绽。
lines.en: It circles you, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 利爪在石头上磨出火星。
lines.en: Its claws scrape sparks from the stone.

lines.zh: 它的喙一次次撞向口套。
lines.en: Its beak keeps striking the muzzle.

lines.zh: 残羽竖起，像一面破旗。
lines.en: Its broken feathers rise like a torn flag.

lines.zh: 它压低身子，翅尖扫过地面。
lines.en: It crouches low, wingtips sweeping the ground.

lines.zh: 喉咙深处滚出咕噜声。
lines.en: A gurgle rolls up from deep in its throat.

lines.zh: 它侧过头，用一只眼看你。
lines.en: It tilts its head and watches you with one eye.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口腐气，试探你。
lines.en: I exhale a breath of rot to test you.

lines.zh: 它在等你自己露出破绽。
lines.en: It waits for you to make the first mistake.

lines.zh: 食腐者的耐心，无限长。
lines.en: A scavenger's patience never runs out.

lines.zh: 我扑下来，爪子先碰到你肩。
lines.en: I dive, my talons finding your shoulder first.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，把月光都遮住。
lines.en: I spread my wings and blot out the moonlight.

lines.zh: 抓向你的脸
lines.en: Grabs at your face

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着进攻
lines.en: Hisses and attacks

lines.zh: 猛啄你的手臂
lines.en: Gives a fierce bite to your arm

lines.zh: 用钩喙撕裂你的皮肤
lines.en: Tears at your skin with hooked beak

lines.zh: 翅膀拍打着你的胸膛
lines.en: Wings thump against your chest

lines.zh: 口套勒着，我只能用翅膀撞。
lines.en: Muzzled, I can only strike with my wings.

lines.zh: 在你身上留下伤痕
lines.en: Leaves scars on your body

lines.zh: 试图将你撕碎
lines.en: Attempts to tear you apart

lines.zh: 隔着口套猛啄你的肩
lines.en: It hammers your shoulder through the muzzle.

lines.zh: 双爪扣住你的手臂
lines.en: Both claws dig into your arm.

lines.zh: 用翅膀把你扇得踉跄
lines.en: A wingbeat knocks you off balance.

lines.zh: 扑到你背上撕扯衣甲
lines.en: It lands on your back and tears at your armor.

lines.zh: 低头撞向你的膝盖
lines.en: It lowers its head and rams your knee.

lines.zh: 喙尖敲得你头盔作响
lines.en: Its beak rings against your helmet.

lines.zh: 在腐肉堆上孵化
lines.en: Hatches from rotting flesh

lines.zh: 从黑暗中出现
lines.en: Emerges from the darkness

lines.zh: 在夜晚的天空中盘旋
lines.en: Circling in the night sky

lines.zh: 寻找可食用的尸体
lines.en: Scours for edible corpses

lines.zh: 在腐烂的动物旁边孵化
lines.en: Hatches near rotting animals

lines.zh: 我从腐肉堆上起飞，找活物。
lines.en: I lift off the carrion heap to look for the living.

lines.zh: 被腐肉吸引而来
lines.en: Drawn by the stench of rot

lines.zh: 夜色落下，我的影子掠过坟地。
lines.en: Night falls, and my shadow sweeps over the graveyard.

lines.zh: 孵化于废弃的营地
lines.en: Hatches at abandoned campsites

lines.zh: 在腐烂的森林中孵化
lines.en: Hatches in the decaying forest

lines.zh: 从骨荒原的裂缝里钻出
lines.en: It climbs out of a crack in the bone wastes.

lines.zh: 循着血腥味落在这片土地
lines.en: It lands here following the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 一群秃鹫从灰云中降下
lines.en: A flock of vultures drops from the grey clouds.

lines.zh: 在血肉平原的低洼处现身
lines.en: It appears in a hollow of the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 被风沙卷着，落在你面前
lines.en: Sand-blown, it drops down in front of you.

lines.zh: 从倒下的旅人身上起飞
lines.en: It takes off from a fallen traveler.

lines.zh: 骨堆里站起一只戴口套的鸟
lines.en: A muzzled bird rises from the bone heap.

lines.zh: 它拖着一截腐肉缓缓落地
lines.en: It lands slowly, dragging a strip of carrion.

lines.zh: 天边传来沙哑的啼叫
lines.en: A hoarse cry sounds from the horizon.

lines.zh: 阴影从天而降，落在你身后
lines.en: A shadow drops from the sky behind you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，疼啊，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ahh, it hurts! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 呜呜，救救我，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Help, please! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 嘶，疼死了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ow, it really hurts! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 呜呜，好痛，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, it hurts! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 嘶，别碰我，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ow, don't touch! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 呜呜，快救我，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Help me! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，好疼，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ow, it hurts so much! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 呜呜，痛死我了，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, it's unbearable! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，疼死我了，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ahh, it hurts so much! — and the void makes it worse.
